snippet.title: Not a Crow: A Dark Hand-Drawn Point & Click Adventure (Teaser)
snippet.description:
Not A Crow is now on Steam!

Not a Crow is a narrative point-and-click adventure. 

Guide a lonely crow through the remnants of a fallen world as she searches for her place among the ruins.

If you want to support the project, please add Not A Crow to your Steam Wishlist. It helps me much more than you can imagine!

Thanks for your support 🖤

🔗 Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4229210/Not_a_Crow/
